usersPanel.emptyFiltered: no accounts match the current filters
usersPanel.emptyNone: nobody exists on this platform yet
usersPanel.disableTail: Nothing changed — the account below is still as it was.

keysPanel.emptyFiltered: no keys match the current filters
keysPanel.emptyNone: no keys have been made yet
keysPanel.revokeBody: {{prefix}} stops working immediately and its grants go with it. Anything still presenting it starts failing to authenticate. This cannot be undone — a replacement is a new key with a new secret.
keysPanel.revokeRefused: The platform refused to revoke the key.
keysPanel.revokeTail: Nothing was revoked — the key below is still working.

grantsPanel.emptyFiltered: no grants match the current filters
grantsPanel.revokeBody: {{subject}} loses {{role}} on {{scope}}. Anything they were doing with it stops answering.
grantsPanel.revokeRefused: The platform refused to revoke the grant.
grantsPanel.revokeTail: Nothing was revoked — the grant below is still in force.

disable.title: Disable this account?
disable.body: {{email}} will not be able to sign in. Their grants stay as they are, and enabling the account restores them exactly.
disable.refused: The platform refused to change this account.
disable.tail: Nothing changed — the account below is still as it was.

userDetail.notFoundBody: No account on this platform has the id <id/>. It may have been removed since this link was written, or the link may have been copied from somewhere that never had it.
userDetail.inertNote: inert while the account is disabled
userDetail.holdsNothing: This account holds nothing — no role on the platform and none on any project. It can sign in and it can see nothing until somebody grants it something.
userDetail.keysNote: An api key is a subject in its own right on this platform: it holds its own roles and answers for itself, so it belongs to no account and there is no such thing as this person's keys. <count/> are in force across the platform.

invitePage.title: New user
invitePage.summary: An account can exist and hold nothing. Roles are granted separately, on the role assignments list.
invitePage.refused: The platform refused to create the account.
invitePage.tail: No account was made — the name and address below are still exactly as you typed them.
invitePage.leaveBody: The name and address you typed are not saved anywhere yet. Leaving this page drops them.

inviteForm.arrivalHint: An invitation waits to be accepted. A local account works immediately.
inviteForm.addressInvalid: that does not look like an address

grantPage.title: Grant a role
grantPage.summary: A grant is a subject, a role and a scope. Nothing else is stored, and nothing else is offered.
grantPage.refused: The platform refused to write the grant.
grantPage.tail: Nothing was granted — the subject, role and scope below are still exactly as you chose them.
grantPage.leaveBody: Nothing has been written yet. Leaving this page drops the subject, role and scope you chose.

grantForm.subjectLooking: Looking up what can hold a role.
grantForm.subjectNone: Nothing of that kind to grant to yet.
grantForm.roleHint: Roles live in code — these six are the whole set, and there is no way to add one.
grantForm.scopeHint: A platform grant holds everywhere. A project grant holds on one project and nowhere else.
grantForm.projectLooking: Looking up which projects a grant can be scoped to.
grantForm.projectNone: No projects to scope a grant to yet.

keyPage.title: New api key
keyPage.summary: A key is a subject in its own right: it is granted roles on the role assignments list, exactly like a person.
keyPage.refused: The platform refused to make the key.
keyPage.tail: No key was made and no secret was generated — the name and lifetime below are still exactly as you chose them.
keyPage.leaveBody: No key has been made and no secret has been generated. Leaving this page drops the name and lifetime you chose.

keyForm.notice: The secret appears once, in a dialog over this page. Copy it there — it is stored hashed, it is not in this page's address, and it cannot be shown again.
keyForm.nameHint: The name is how the key is recognised in the list. It is not part of the secret.
keyForm.expiresHint: A key with no expiry is a key nobody will notice is still working.
keyForm.tenantLooking: Looking up which projects a key can be scoped to.
keyForm.tenantHint: Optional. When set, the key only authenticates requests carrying the matching X-Comuki-Tenant header.

secretDialog.title: Key created
secretDialog.notice: This is the only time this secret is shown. Once this dialog closes it is gone — the platform keeps the prefix and a hash, and nothing else.
secretDialog.secretHint: Stored as {{prefix}}. That prefix is all the key list will ever show.

linkPage.title: Link an oidc subject
linkPage.summary: The provider's subject for {{email}}. Roles stay here — the provider says who they are, not what they hold.
linkPage.alreadyLinked: This account is already linked to {{subject}}. A subject is written once; changing it is a platform operation, not a screen.
linkPage.missing: No account on this platform has that id. It may have been removed since the link was opened.
linkPage.refused: The platform refused to write the subject.
linkPage.tail: Nothing was linked — the account is still local only, and the subject below is still exactly as you typed it.
linkPage.leaveBody: The subject you typed is not saved anywhere yet. Leaving this page drops it, and the account stays local only.

linkForm.subjectHint: The `sub` claim the provider issues for this person.
